automation_name: AI Dev Wiki Topic News Collector

cutoff_window.date_policy: A source needs a visible publication or update date that unambiguously falls inside this interval. A date-only value on the lower-boundary calendar date is excluded because its time is unknown.

federation.collector_rule: Retain only an AI-assisted-development practice implication when a source concerns an upstream-owned entity.

source.title: Work from anywhere with a new, connected Copilot cloud experience
source.date_basis: The first-party changelog page visibly states October 28, 2026; this is unambiguously inside the two-day interval.

qualifying_updates.short_factual_summary: GitHub announced a connected cloud agent experience in which a session can move among web, mobile, CLI, app, IDE, Slack, and Teams surfaces. Sessions run in resumable cloud sandboxes by default; the announcement also describes cross-surface context, local or remote custom MCP configuration, approval-gated tool calls, organization MCP allowlists, SSO-scoped session data, and automatic read-only access when a user lacks repository write access.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: Treat a coding-agent session as a portable, governed work item: preserve task context and session provenance across handoffs; record the execution environment and snapshot boundary; use explicit MCP allowlists and per-tool approval rules; and verify repository authority before permitting mutations. A team adopting cross-surface agents also needs a compute-budget and audit model because sandboxes consume shared build capacity.
follow_up_notes: If ingested, route only the portable-session, sandbox-boundary, permission, allowlist, read-only fallback, and compute-governance guidance into downstream practice pages.
Do not create local product, vendor, protocol, or MCP-server encyclopedia pages; use the upstream AI wiki for those entities.
